scope: Native vLLM runtime for inkling-2-mini; no qualification claim
status: DRAFT: packages, freeze_sha256, vllm_tree and gpu_selftest are filled from the finished install, never estimated

interpreter.source: uv-managed CPython 3.12.13 (cpython-3.12.13-linux-aarch64-gnu), copied as a relocatable tree (same interpreter bytes as the qwen3.8-flash-next runtime)

patches.name: vllm PR #69288 [Inkling2] round the off-TRT-LLM-gen expert_plan max_ctas bound up to a power of two (SM12x)
patches.scope: vllm/ paths only (the PR's tests/ hunk is excluded)

patches.name: local gate: INKLING2_MAX_CTAS_POW2 around 0001
patches.enabled_by: INKLING2_MAX_CTAS_POW2=1 (read once at import, only 0 or 1, default off: the unpatched exact bound)

patch_command: git apply, in order, run in runtime/lib/python3.12/site-packages
install_command: uv pip install --python runtime/bin/python3 <vllm wheel> --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match

flashinfer_jit_cache.why: AOT kernels so startup never JIT-compiles; profiles set FLASHINFER_DISABLE_JIT=1, so a missing module fails the load instead of running nvcc beside the model
flashinfer_jit_cache.install_command: uv pip install --python runtime/bin/python3 --no-deps <the three wheels below>
